home.title: QuackMuzik 🦆🎵
home.subtitle: Discord music bot built with Lavalink, supporting multiple music platforms (YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music, SoundCloud, Deezer, and more) with text-to-speech capabilities.
home.quickStartDesc: QuackMuzik is designed for easy deployment and use:
home.quickStartItem1: Docker Compose: Run bot, Lavalink and database with a single command
home.quickStartItem2: Kubernetes: Helm charts available for production deployment
home.quickStartItem3: CI/CD: GitHub Actions automatically builds and deploys
home.docGuide: 📘 User Guide - Detailed guide on how to use the bot, commands, and configuration

guide.troubleshootingBotNotRespondingItem1: Check MESSAGE CONTENT INTENT is enabled in Discord Developer Portal → Bot → Privileged Gateway Intents
guide.troubleshootingBotNotRespondingItem2: Verify bot has proper permissions in the server
guide.troubleshootingBotNotRespondingItem3: Check bot is in the server - Verify bot appears in member list
guide.troubleshootingBotNotRespondingItem4: Check prefix - Default prefix is z! (can be changed with z!prefix)
guide.troubleshootingBotNotRespondingItem5: Check bot logs: docker-compose logs bot
guide.troubleshootingMusicNotPlayingItem1: Ensure bot has Connect and Speak permissions in voice channel
guide.troubleshootingMusicNotPlayingItem2: Check Lavalink is running: docker-compose logs lavalink
guide.troubleshootingTtsNotWorkingItem1: Verify FloweryTTS plugin is enabled in lavalink/application.yml
guide.troubleshootingTtsNotWorkingItem2: Restart Lavalink after config changes: docker-compose restart lavalink
guide.troubleshootingYoutubeIssuesItem1: Check yt-cipher service is healthy: docker-compose ps yt-cipher
guide.troubleshootingYoutubeIssuesItem2: Verify yt-cipher endpoint in Lavalink config
